title: "Indicators"

About this site

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(rjson)
library(reactable)

indicators_dir <- "../indicators/"

fls <- indicators_dir |> list.files(full.names = TRUE, pattern = "json") 

indicators_dt <- list()

for(i in seq_along(fls)) {

    json_data <- fls[i] |>
        readLines() |>
        paste(collapse = "") |>
        fromJSON()

    json_data$keywords <- json_data$keywords |> paste(collapse = ", ")

    indicators_dt[[i]] <- json_data

}

indicators_dt <- indicators_dt |> rbindlist(idcol = "id", use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

reactable(
  indicators_dt,

  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  sortable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  bordered = FALSE,

  defaultPageSize = 10,
  pageSizeOptions = c(10, 25, 50, 100),

  paginationType = "jump",

  defaultColDef = colDef(
    resizable = TRUE,
    minWidth = 120,
    headerStyle = list(
      background = "#5544cc",
      color = "white",
      fontWeight = "600",
      borderBottom = "none"
    ),
    style = list(
      padding = "12px",
      whiteSpace = "normal",
      lineHeight = "1.4"
    )
  ),

  columns = list(
    id = colDef(
      name = "ID",
      width = 70,
      align = "center"
    ),

    keywords = colDef(
      name = "Keywords",
      minWidth = 220,
      style = list(
        color = "#5544cc",
        fontSize = "0.85rem"
      )
    )
  ),

  theme = reactableTheme(
    borderColor = "#e5e5e5",

    stripedColor = "#f8f7ff",
    highlightColor = "#eeeaff",

    cellPadding = "10px 12px",

    style = list(
      fontFamily = "Comfortaa, sans-serif",
      fontSize = "0.9rem"
    ),

    searchInputStyle = list(
      border = "1px solid #d6d2ee",
      borderRadius = "6px",
      padding = "8px 12px"
    ),

    selectStyle = list(
      border = "1px solid #d6d2ee",
      borderRadius = "6px"
    )
  )
)
```
